summary: Particle collision spawn handler. When a collision source a2 and a live render-state list exist, stores the source into this+0x0, computes the bounding box at the collision point via BoundingBoxComputation, re-centers this+0x4/+0x8/+0xC onto the box midpoint, stores the half-extent into this+0x10, and (when the vertical extent is positive) seeds spread direction and magnitude from the noise table flt_8AB274 using the byte-wrapped index dword_8AAE70, writes scale/lifetime/angular-rate/direction components into this+0x18..this+0x30, counts elements above the collision height into this+0x34, and allocates a 20-byte-per-record buffer at this+0x38 that is filled with the filtered element pointers, their position floats and squared vertical deltas.

local_names.this: particle spawn output record (center, half-extent, scatter parameters, filtered buffer)
local_names.v27_v32: bounding-box extent locals produced by BoundingBoxComputation
local_names.v28: lower vertical box extent used as the collision height threshold
local_names.v6: vertical box extent v31 - v28, the branch trigger
local_names.v36: sine of the noise-derived angle, kept before sign flipping
local_names.v16: weight v15*0.2 + 0.5 applied to the direction components

operations.description: Handler only proceeds when the collision source a2 is non-zero and LinkedListIndexedAccessor_c230(0) returns a live list v3
Store the collision source pointer into this+0x0
BoundingBoxComputation(&v30) fills the box extent locals (v27..v32) at the collision point
TripleFieldQuery(this+1, this+2, this+3) pulls the stored center components this+0x4 / this+0x8 / this+0xC into the query path
Combine the bounding-box extent locals into center offsets: v34 = v29 + v32, v35 = (v27 + v30) * 0.5, v4 = (v31 + v28) * 0.5, v5 = v34 * 0.5
Offset the stored collision center this+0x4 / this+0x8 / this+0xC by the computed box-center deltas
this+0x10 = 0.5 * sqrt(sum of squared box-extent differences): the collision bounding-sphere half-extent (radius)
Vertical spread branch: only when the box vertical extent v6 = v31 - v28 is positive do the particle-scatter, counting, allocation and fill steps run
Sample the noise table flt_8AB274 with the byte-wrapped post-increment index dword_8AAE70: write this+0x18 = noise * 0.15000001 + 1.0 and this+0x1C = 0.00094 (scale and lifetime constants)
this+0x20 = (noise * 0.40000001 + 2.8) * 6.283185307179586 / (v6 + 3.0): angular spread rate from the noise sample and the vertical extent

Noise-derived direction angle v9 = flt_8AB274[...] * 0.5 + 0.69999999: the cosine is stored to this+0x24 and the sine to this+0x28, then the sign quadrant is chosen from the next noise sample (>= 0.2 negates the sine, else the cosine), and v16 = noise * 0.2 + 0.5 weights the components written to this+0x2C and this+0x30
Counting pass: reset this+0x34 to 0, then for each of PackedArrayTotalSize(v3) elements from PackedArrayIndexLookup increment this+0x34 when the element float at +4 exceeds the vertical extent v28
Allocate the filtered record buffer: this+0x38 = OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(20 * this+0x34) — 20-byte records for the counted elements

Fill pass: for each PackedArrayIndexLookup element whose float at +1 exceeds v28, write the element pointer into buffer record offset 0, copy its three floats (+0/+1/+2) into record offsets 4/8/12, and write the squared vertical delta (float+1 - v28)^2 into record offset 16; records advance 20 bytes
